first_party_analytics_enrichment.would_strengthen: CTR/IMPRESSIONS would confirm whether TITLE/HOOK archetype associations reflect actual click behavior rather than post-click retention alone; RETENTION/AVD would let root_cause_layers distinguish HOOK_PROMISE_MATCH from SCRIPT_STRUCTURE failure instead of inferring both from views_per_day; WATCH_TIME/TRAFFIC_SOURCES would let family_health separate organic-search repeatability from suggested/browse-driven one-off spikes; NEW_CASUAL_REGULAR_VIEWERS/AUDIENCE_OVERLAP would let ROBUST_CROSS_CHANNEL_PATTERN require actual shared-audience overlap with the benchmark channel(s) rather than independent structural recurrence alone.
